cards.answer: Nunu & Willump are a tank/mage duo who engage with a rolling snowball knock-up and follow with a delayed root or a channeled blizzard. Their abilities deal magic damage to champions, with AP and health supporting damage, healing or shielding.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the rolling snowball, move away before the root triggers, and leave the blizzard area early.

cards.answer: Call of the Freljord triggers when the duo damage an enemy champion, large monster or structure, granting them and a nearby allied champion attack speed and movement speed. While active, Willump's basic attacks also deal physical splash damage in a cone.
cards.counterplay: Avoid clustering in front of Willump during his empowered attacks, and respect the nearby ally's increased speed.

facts.claim: While active, Willump's basic attacks also deal physical splash damage in a cone.

cards.priority_reason: The shared speed buff and splash damage strengthen nearby allies and clustered fights.

cards.answer: Consume bites an enemy and heals Willump, with increased healing at low health. It deals true damage to minions and monsters, but magic damage and reduced healing against champions.
cards.counterplay: Account for his healing when committing to a fight, especially near minions or monsters.

citations.quote: Willump takes a bite out of the target enemy, dealing damage and healing himself. The heal is increased when he is below half health.

facts.claim: Consume bites an enemy and heals Willump, with increased healing at low health.

citations.quote: Against minions and monsters he deals true damage. Against champions he deals magic damage and the heal is reduced.

facts.claim: It deals true damage to minions and monsters, but magic damage and reduced healing against champions.

cards.priority_reason: Healing changes kill attempts, while monster damage matters in objective contests.

cards.answer: Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls a steerable snowball that grows in size, speed and damage as it charges. Willump removes slows and becomes slow-immune while rolling; hitting a champion explodes the snowball for area magic damage, a knock-up and a size-dependent stun. He can release it to roll forward without him.
cards.counterplay: Move sideways out of its path and use terrain to obstruct the approach; avoid relying on slows during the roll.

citations.quote: Willump can gradually steer the snowball during this time.
a snowball that grows in size and speed
The snowball increases in size and power linearly over the duration.

facts.claim: Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls a steerable snowball that grows in size, speed and damage as it charges.

citations.quote: Willump cleanses himself from all slows and channels for up to 10 seconds, becoming ghosted and slow-immune

When hitting an enemy champion, large monster or terrain, the snowball instead explodes, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, and briefly knocking them up then stunning them based on the snowball's size.

facts.claim: Willump removes slows and becomes slow-immune while rolling; hitting a champion explodes the snowball for area magic damage, a knock-up and a size-dependent stun.

cards.answer: Snowball Barrage throws repeatable volleys that deal magic damage and slow enemies after repeated hits. A snowball hit marks champions and large monsters; after a delay, marked targets near Willump take additional magic damage and are rooted.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the volleys and move away from Willump after being hit to avoid the delayed root.

citations.quote: Nunu throws a volley of 3 snowballs in the target direction that each shatter upon hitting an enemy, dealing magic damage to enemies in a cone. Enemies hit 3 times are briefly slowed.
Recast: Nunu hurls another volley of snowballs.

facts.claim: Snowball Barrage throws repeatable volleys that deal magic damage and slow enemies after repeated hits.

facts.claim: A snowball hit marks champions and large monsters; after a delay, marked targets near Willump take additional magic damage and are rooted.

cards.priority_reason: The proximity requirement creates a practical chance to avoid follow-up control.

cards.answer: Absolute Zero channels a blizzard, granting the duo a shield and increasingly slowing nearby enemies. It explodes for area magic damage when the channel ends, with more damage from a longer channel; they can release it early.
cards.counterplay: Leave the area early or interrupt the channel to limit its damage; account for the shield when attacking.

citations.quote: Nunu and Willump channel a blizzard for a short time, gaining a shield and gradually slowing nearby enemies.

facts.claim: Absolute Zero channels a blizzard, granting the duo a shield and increasingly slowing nearby enemies.

Recast: Nunu and Willump cause the blizzard to explode, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, modified to 0% – 100% (based on channel time).

facts.claim: It explodes for area magic damage when the channel ends, with more damage from a longer channel; they can release it early.

cards.priority_reason: The increasing slow, shield and delayed damage demand an early response.
